guide.title: How to play
guide.p1.title: Taking a shot
guide.p1.b1: Put the pointer on the white ball and circle round it: the cue turns, like a dial.
guide.p1.b2: Press and pull away from where you want the ball to go: the further you pull, the harder the shot, and the cue turns from cyan to orange, then white-hot. You can still change the aim while pulling.
guide.p1.b3: Let go to shoot. A very short pull, or a right click, cancels the shot.
guide.p1.b4: While you pull, the bright line shows what the white ball will touch first.
guide.p2.title: Goal and groups
guide.p2.b1: Solo 8-ball: sink all the balls of your group, then the 8-ball.
guide.p2.b2: The first shot is the break. After it the table is "open": the first ball you legally sink picks your group: SOLIDS (1–7) or STRIPES (9–15).
guide.p2.b3: The side panel counts your shots, fouls and the balls left.
guide.p3.title: Fouls
guide.p3.b1: The white ball falls into a pocket.
guide.p3.b3: Wrong first ball: one of the other group, or the 8 while you still have balls of your group.
guide.p3.b4: After contact, no ball is pocketed and none reaches a cushion.
guide.p3.b5: A shot counts at most 1 foul (shown in the side panel). After a foul you place the white ball again.
guide.p4.title: Ball in hand
guide.p4.b1: After a foul the white ball pulses with a pink ring: press it.
guide.p4.b2: Drag it where you want it. It cannot go on another ball or in a pocket mouth (red ring).
guide.p4.b3: Let go on the green ring, then shoot as usual.
guide.p5.title: Winning and losing
guide.p5.b1: WIN: clear your group, then sink the 8 in a shot without a foul.
guide.p5.b2: LOSE: the 8 goes in while you still have balls of your group, or in a shot with a foul.
guide.p5.b3: The 8 goes in on the break: the balls are racked again, no penalty.
guide.p6.title: Keys
settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: ↑ ↓ choose a row, ← → change, Esc closes
guide.p1.b5: For a high or low hit, see the Keys page.
guide.p6.b2: Roll the mouse wheel, or press and drag the dot on the small ball in the side panel: up strikes high (the white ball runs on after the hit), down strikes low (it comes back). The dot stays where you left it after each shot; a new game puts it back in the middle.
